lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form a matrix-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity values on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more closely packed than those on the main lateral flank.
